manual_review_reason: BayFM's official contact form offers a Music subject, genre field, message field and CAPTCHA but does not expressly authorize unsolicited audio delivery or publish file/link, metadata, international-eligibility, explicit-content or AI-origin requirements. A human may submit only an asset-free inquiry asking for the current airplay-submission process, must complete the CAPTCHA manually, and must not send music, files or private links until BayFM confirms an authorized route.
